reason: The analyst controls for collab_index_2023, a post-treatment mediator or collider, and this drives the -2.73 estimate. My analysis without it, using pre-period controls, gives about -0.28 (p≈0.25), which is no detectable effect. The analyst also trims the outcome at 1% and reports only one specification with no robustness checks, so the 'negative effect' conclusion is not supported.
